how.h2: Sampling in their hands. Digital that expands it. CRM that keeps them.
steps: Your product, delivered at the moment of need through clinics, schools and universities. Real trial — the start of the experience, not the whole story.
A printed or digital guide with every box. Your brand earns a useful place while the experience moves from physical trial toward online.
Opt-in, GDPR-compliant registration collects email, phone, mobile and address — then we build CRM, loyalty journeys and targeted email (and SMS or mail where they fit) for each market.
Care Direct's in-house Online Platforms keep the audience close, educate them after the sample, and roll them into the next START.

items.q: What is START by Care Direct?
items.a: START is Care Direct's family of complete life-stage experiences. Each one starts with product sampling at a moment of change, then expands digitally — guides, Online Platforms, and consented CRM, loyalty and targeted email.
START runs across Southeast Europe: Greece, Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia.

items.q: How does a START program work?
items.a: Sampling in the kit, a printed or digital guide, then GDPR-compliant registration that fuels CRM and targeted email, plus Care Direct Online Platforms that keep the conversation going after the freebie.
Brand marketers and agencies that need a full experience — real product trial plus digital expansion and first-party CRM — not only a one-off handout or digital impressions alone.
